King James Drive Southwest — STREET VIEW — walkable v12

The dark ribbon is King James Drive Southwest at its true width, segmented every 2.5 m with every point's height set from the ground, so it rides on the surface instead of diving through the hill (the red marker stands at the old worst spot). A red car is parked on the street next to the character - walk up to it and press E or the 🚗 Get in button to drive. Driving uses big press-and-hold buttons - ◀ ▶ steer (bottom left) and GAS / BRAKE pedals (bottom right) - or the keys (W/S or ↑/↓ = gas & brake/reverse, A/D or ←/→ = steer). Press E again to get out. While you drive, the view sits on the roof of the car, facing forward, turning and leaning with the car, tilted up so only a sliver of hood shows at the bottom of the screen. New in v12: (1) Every street in the full one-mile radius now gets the segment-and-conform fix - all 520 road records, not just the ones that ran underground (about 7.1 km of road had been buried; worst after King James itself: King Arthur Road, 11.3 m under). (2) Houses that were sitting on streets were moved off them - see the buildings line under this panel. (3) The roof camera is now adjusted from a camera panel: tap the 📷 button while driving to move the camera (Forward / Back / Left / Right / Up / Down) and tilt it, then Save camera to keep the whole setup on this device. This is the transform only - not baked; the real map data is untouched. The light-blue road is King James seen through the ground (toggle: X-ray street). Walk with the joystick (bottom left) or keys; drive with the buttons or keys - the readout should say on the surface everywhere. Drag pans, two fingers orbit.
